title: Software Engineer II, Backend
text:
Meridian Insurance is modernizing its claims platform. We're hiring a Software Engineer II to build backend services.

Responsibilities
- Develop microservices in Java 17 with Spring Boot, deployed to Azure Kubernetes Service.
- Design RESTful APIs and integrate with partner systems through RabbitMQ.
- Work with SQL Server and MongoDB; write efficient queries and migrations.
- Practice TDD with JUnit; maintain build pipelines in Jenkins and Maven.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies (Scrum) and code reviews.
- Apply secure coding practices and OAuth2 for service authentication.

Minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
- 2+ years of experience with Java and object-oriented programming.
- Experience with Docker and Git.

Preferred
- Experience with Kafka and event-driven architecture.
- Azure certification.
